artifact.title: Status Report
artifact.description: An AI-assisted project status summary generated from live tasks, time logs, and materials, reviewed by the PM and shareable with the client.

fields.description: Primary identifier of the status report.
Reference to the project this status report belongs to.
Lifecycle state of the report: draft, reviewed, or shared with the client.
Start date of the reporting period covered by this status report.
End date of the reporting period covered by this status report.
AI-generated narrative summary of overall project status for the period.
AI-generated overview of task progress derived from live work tasks.
AI-generated overview of hours logged derived from live time logs.
AI-generated overview of material consumption derived from live material usage.
AI-generated assessment of delay risks based on project data and associated delay-risk suggestions.
Notes or edits added by the project manager during review of the report.
Timestamp when the AI generated the initial report content.
Timestamp when the project manager completed review and moved the report to reviewed state.
Timestamp when the report was shared with the client.
Record creation timestamp.
Last update timestamp for the record.
